sources.title: TiDE clinical text Safe Harbor - STAnford medicine Research data Repository
sources.snippet: Prior assessments, by Ferrández et al, of clinical text Safe Harbor PHI scrubbing techniques show that it is difficult to find a single approach that performs well in all cases. Clinical narratives can be fragmented and lack formatting, making the use of pre-trained traditional newswire Name Entity Recognition (NER) approaches limiting.
